svg.title: The Governance-Management Interface for Quality: What Goes Where and When
svg.desc: Diagram of the loop between the governing body and management: the governing body split across direction and reevaluation, the continuous accountability record, and active oversight for escalations and assurance; the six-part statement flowing down to govern both the four-step QA loop and daily two-step decisions; raw evidence produced by the QA loop and AI build work kept locally and sampled at reevaluation and on demand; five upward reports (R1 to R5) ordered from fastest to slowest cadence plus refreshed Part 2 departmental trends routed to reevaluation and the accountability record.

g.text: Governance-Management Interface: What Goes Where and When
Owners & members (purpose), laws & regulators, customer contracts
Answers to owners & members, regulators, auditors, and courts
Board, supervisory board, or founders (executive management drafts; the body ratifies & answers)
· Corrects ranges, reviews appetite, remakes statement
· Reopens bets on law, market, deal, or strategy shifts
In: R1, R2, R4, R5 + Part 2 trends + assurance findings
· Current risk sizes next to appetite (R2)
· Risks accepted in writing inside limits (R3)
· Decides escalated cases; grants or refuses
Start · Reeval · Bet review · Shift / broken limit
Purpose, where to win, AI scope, 2-step rule
Baseline numbers each department answers for
Target, floor, return & cost ranges, review
Law & contract floors, safety margin, checks
As good as usual; normal care, no extra spend
Bounds per risk, escalation size, sign-offs;
AI rules, agent limits & knowledge appetite
Counts as published only when used daily
↑ WHAT FLOWS UP: REPORTS R1-R5 + TRENDS
Fastest to slowest cadence; measured vs bounds
At once: breach or stakes shift
On stakes shift: fresh reports on affected
R2. Current size of each risk
Vs appetite (incl. knowledge risk); unsupported tags
Signed locally: owner, reason, review date
Actual vs range + why (est., work, or world)
Bet on Part 5 need; drop/re-fund; limits
All dept baselines (checks Part 5 rule too)
4-Step QA Loop, Dept Tracking & AI Prevention
· Dept heads track Part 2 numbers & distances to Part 4 minimums
· Step 1-2: Price failure from Part 3 worth; rank vs Part 6 (→ R2, R3)
· Step 3-4: Pick checks inside bet cost; rebalance on schedule/shifts
· Human-decided small pieces (Part 6 limit) funded by Part 3 bet
· Tag code-derived tests as unsupported in R2; watch knowledge risk
· Re-run human eval suite on tool updates (checks tool & people)
Price both first: Product+Eng feature delay cost;
QA+Eng expected failure loss (from Part 3 worth)
Escalation size, Part 4 minimums, Part 3 floors,
Crosses any: mitigate first or escalate both ↑
Weigh delay cost vs failure loss waiting removes;
pick better option, zero meetings (accepted → R3)
All Part 2 department heads + Product, Engineering, QA, Support, Operations, Legal & Compliance
